scope: Full current fixture-only ordinary and relocation purge process crash tests
assessment: Actual owned SIGKILL at purge intent, file checkpoint/deletion and terminal receipt boundaries
Public CLI resumes original ordinary and relocation purge plans after child process death
Relocation inventory retains exact original plan and full expected file list while PURGING; active independent recovery remains valid
Ordinary maintenance reports INCOMPLETE then PASS, removes quarantined fixture object while retaining artifact metadata
limitations: Only disposable test media deleted; no real product purge authorization implied
Instrumentation selects kill boundaries; not power loss or every syscall interruption
Single-filesystem fixtures rather than real products, cross-volume or browser acceptance
